description: This is a set of Robolectric-based screenshot tests for the Navigation component of a Jetpack Compose Android app, utilizing Material3 components, themes, and custom design system elements from the 'nowinandroid' project. The tests include multi-theme rendering and simulating a large font scale to verify UI consistency.

classes.name: NavigationScreenshotTests
classes.description: A test class running Robolectric-based screenshot tests for navigation UI components with multi-theme and font scaling scenarios.

methods.name: navigation_multipleThemes
methods.description: Test method capturing the Navigation component rendered under multiple themes to verify visual correctness across themes.

methods.name: navigation_hugeFont
methods.description: Test method that sets a large font scale to simulate accessibility settings and captures a screenshot for UI verification.

methods.name: NiaNavigationBarExample
methods.description: Composable function rendering a navigation bar with multiple items, used within tests to generate the UI.
